If benefits were paid on the most recent claim and the Violation History (ML02) screen does not display the cancelled BP as a BPC that was affected by a violation:
Remarks lines 1–4: Type “Benefits processed on BPC [BPC of BP to void] to be processed on previous BP and BPC [BPC of BP to void] voided. Remove processed weeks from the PHS. Create OP for paid weeks. Convert BPC [BPC of BP to void]. Advise adjudicator with REM WI when complete.”

If benefits were paid on the most recent claim the Violation History (ML02) screen displays the cancelled BP as a BPC that was affected by a violation:
Remarks lines 1–4: Type “Benefits processed on BPC [BPC of BP to void] to be processed on previous BP and BPC [BPC of BP to void] voided. Remove processed weeks from the PHS. Create OP for paid weeks. Convert BPC [BPC of BP to void]. Update ML02 for BPC [BPC with violation that affected the BP to void] and remove BPC [BPC of the BP to void] as a BPC affected by a violation. Advise adjudicator with REM WI when complete.”

If benefits were not paid on the most recent claim the Violation History (ML02) screen displays the cancelled BP as a BPC that was affected by a violation:

Convert BPC [BPC of BP to void] and update ML02 for BPC [BPC with the violation that affected the BP to void] and remove BPC [BPC of BP to void] as an affected BPC. Advise adjudicator with REM WI when complete.”
